description: The one source of the Crimson Noir design tokens. src/brand/tokens.css carries the same values for the page (Tailwind reads them through @theme); the Crimson Terminal's constants in crimson_noir_os/crates/noir_core/src/term.rs are the terminal group below, value for value. brand/STYLE.md says how they are used.

black.role: Vantablack: the boot veil, the terminal shell's page, the mark's field

ink.role: the base surface of every screen

ink-2.role: the Crimson Terminal's background; a sunk panel

crimson.role: the one accent: the rule under a header, the live indicator, an error line, a selected edge

crimson-deep.role: the header bar of the terminal; a crimson surface

crimson-rule.role: the hairline above the input line

white.role: an echoed command; the one-colour mark's skyline

display.value: system-ui, -apple-system, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI Variable Display', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
display.note: no web font: the page's CSP admits no font host, and the system face is the Apple-grade one on every platform

text.value: system-ui, -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

mono.value: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace

mark.triangle: equilateral on a 120 grid: apex 60,25, base 30,77 to 90,77; inner apex 60,48, base 46,72 to 74,72
mark.accent: #e8203a fills the inner triangle; the outer band is #c8c8cc
